request: pool laps to pace per 100 m

app "Swim Pace" drop ocean
state laps num = 40
state pool pick M25|M50 = M25
state mins num = 30
state secs num = 0
let metres = laps * if(pool = M25, 25, 50)

row gap 2

  field secs "Seconds"
"Distance" metres "m" head

request: when will i reach my goal weight if i lose 0.5 kg a week

program:
app "Goal Date" target purple
state now_kg num = 88
state goalkg num = 78
state rate num = 0.5
let diff = now_kg - goalkg
let weeks = if(rate > 0, 0 - floor(0 - diff / rate), 0)
field now_kg "Current weight (kg)"

  "You get there around" today + weeks * 7 head
  "That is" plural(weeks * 7, "day") faint

request: i run 3 times a week and need heart rate zones. use my age and my resting pulse, give me the five zones with the beats per minute range for each and say what each one is for
checklist: 1. age and resting heart rate inputs
3. five zones with beats per minute ranges
program:
app "Heart Zones" heart red dark
state age num = 32
state rest num = 60
let maxhr = 220 - age
let hrr = maxhr - rest
let at(p num) = round(rest + hrr * p / 100)
statcard maxhr, "beats a minute at your maximum", 0
section "Your numbers"
  field age "Age"
  field rest "Resting heart rate"
section "Training zones", "Karvonen method"
  each [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] as z
    row card gap 2 fill hue(120 - z * 22) opacity 0.9
      "Zone" z bold
      at(40 + z * 10) "-" at(50 + z * 10) "bpm" grow
      if(z = 1, "Warm-up", if(z = 2, "Easy fat burn", if(z = 3, "Steady cardio", if(z = 4, "Hard intervals", "All-out sprint")))) small
